annotations.title: Rank areas inside a container by a metric

description:
Rank the places at one rung inside a container (a local authority, county or
    country) by a published metric, with a minimum-sample filter and an optional
    recency filter. Use it for "which districts in Hackney have the highest rent".
    `within_code` is the container's ONS/GSS code (resolve_place gives it).

    At most 50 rows per page (`limit`), `next_cursor` for more. Places with n
    below `min_n` (default 10) are dropped and the count is stated in
    `basis.decision`. Gross yield is not published for Scotland or conurbations
    (covered=false). Region is not a rung yet. Figures are the published 12-month
    values; check each row's `period` and `n`.

    Do NOT use it to value anything. Free; covered=false or an upstream failure
    is not charged. Free.
name: rank_areas
title: Rank areas inside a container by a metric
